title: Enhancing perovskite solar cell efficiency: ZnO–WO3 as an electron transport layer to minimize recombination losses
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25019-25029
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03446A, Paper
Open Access

Ali Mujtaba, M. I. Khan, Mongi Amami, Dhafer O. Alshahrani
The TiO2\ZnO–WO3-based device PCE improved due to the combined effects of optimized energy level alignment by WO3, less recombination losses, and quicker carrier dynamics by ZnO.
